chapter.verse: Pasian aw, ka thumna aw hong za in; gal launa panin kei hong kem in,
migilote’ sawm simna, thusia bawlte’ vaihawmna,
namsau banga a leii uh a tatte, thaltang banga thu hoih lo a ngimte,
a buk simna panun mawh baang lo mi a kapte, lau het loin thakhatin amah a kapte’ kiang panin kei hong liah in.
Amaute in a thusia ngaihsutna uh len kip uh hi; amaute in thang siahsim ding gen uh a, “Eite kua in hong mu ding ahi hiam?
Eite’ mawhna kua in hong kankhia zo ding ahi hiam? Siam mahmahna tawh i sawm simna i ngaihsun khia hi,” ci-in ngaihsun uh hi. Bang hang hiam cih leh mihingte’ sung thu leh lungsim thuk mahmah hi.
Ahih hangin Pasian in a thaltang tawh amaute kap ding hi; amaute thakhatin liam ding uh hi.
Amau’ kampauna hangin amah in amaute siatna ngah sak ding a, amau a mu khempeuh in a lu uh peisan ding uh hi.
Tua ciangin mi khempeuh lau ding uh hi; amaute in Pasian hihsa thute gen ding uh a, ama hihsate ngaihsunsun ding uh hi.
Topa ’ sungah midikte lungdam ding uh a, ama sungah bu ding uh hi. Lungsim thutangte khempeuh in amah phat ding uh hi.
